oneos.description: OneOS runs a second Android system next to One UI on a rooted Samsung Galaxy and switches between the two without flashing anything. One UI stays installed; the other system lives in a folder on the phone and starts on One UI's kernel as a container with its own zygote and system_server. You switch from the OneOS app and come back with Back to One UI (the OneOS app inside the other system) or by holding Volume Up + Volume Down for 3 seconds.
